Operations for a specific internal object kind. Use 'fields' subcommand to explore available fields.

Usage:
  zqk internal lifecycle [flags]
  zqk internal lifecycle [command]

Available Commands:
  fields      List available fields for this internal object kind

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk internal lifecycle [command] --help" for more information about a command.
